# VMS — Vehicle Workshop Stores / Inventory Management

> Self-hosted inventory system (Next.js 14 + Postgres). This document is
> the machine-readable manifest of its agent-facing surface. A live
> version (with your deployment's real base URL and the current tool
> registry) is always available at `GET /api/llms`; the OpenAPI 3.0 spec
> is at `GET /api/v1/openapi.json`.

Base URL below assumes the local default `http://localhost:3000`.

## Authentication

Two credentials, checked in order:

1. **API key** — `Authorization: Bearer vms_…`. Scoped keys are issued at
   `/dashboard/integrations` (create/list/revoke). The plaintext key is
   shown once; the server stores a sha256 hash. Scopes: read | write |
   admin — a read key cannot POST and cannot call write MCP tools.
2. **Dashboard session cookie** — same identity, implicitly fully scoped.

Either way, the owner's ROLE governs what is actually allowed (the
permission matrix is re-checked server-side on every request).

Rate limit: 60 requests/minute per key (per user for sessions);
429 + Retry-After on excess. Error envelope:
`{ "error": { "code": "unauthenticated|forbidden|forbidden_scope|validation|not_found|conflict|rate_limited|internal", "message": "…" } }`

## MCP endpoint

`POST /api/mcp` — JSON-RPC 2.0, single HTTP POST transport (no SSE).
Methods: `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `resources/list`,
`resources/read`, `ping`. Batch requests supported; notifications → 202.

Tools (read = read scope; write = write scope; role matrix still applies):

- `search_products` (read) — search catalog by SKU/name
- `get_stock_level` (read) — on-hand level for one product
- `get_product_by_barcode` (read) — lookup by code (SKU until barcode table lands)
- `list_low_stock` (read) — everything at/below min_threshold
- `list_loans` (read) — tool custody list
- `list_stock_takes` (read) — stock takes with progress
- `get_stock_take_items` (read) — counted items for a take
- `list_storerooms` (read) — graceful not-yet-implemented (returns bin locations)
- `run_report` (read) — stock_summary | low_stock | movements | loans
- `post_stock_movement` (write) — append a ledger row
- `checkout_tool` (write) — create a tool loan
- `checkin_tool` (write) — return a tool loan
- `start_stock_take` (write) — open a count

## REST API v1

Base: `/api/v1` — spec: `/api/v1/openapi.json`

| Route | Methods | Scope | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| /health | GET | none | liveness + DB probe |
| /products | GET, POST | read / write | ?q= ?item_type= ?limit= ?offset= |
| /products/{idOrSku} | GET, PATCH | read / write | |
| /stock | GET | read | ?product_id= ?sku= ?only_low=1 |
| /movements | GET, POST | read / write | ledger; own rows unless read:all role |
| /loans | GET, POST | read / write | POST ?action=return to check in |
| /takes | GET, POST | read / write | ?id=<uuid> returns take items |
| /low-stock | GET | read | at/below min_threshold |
| /audit | GET | admin | + admin/super_admin role |
| /openapi.json | GET | none | OpenAPI 3.0 spec |

Quickstart:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer vms_…" http://localhost:3000/api/v1/stock
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/mcp \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer vms_…" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
```
